exposure: bupivacaine infiltration along the spinal needle track
outcome: analgesic usage for post-spinal back pain
cohort: The study included 60 patients receiving spinal anesthesia for elective cesarean sections at Erbil Maternity Teaching Hospital.
finding: Bupivacaine infiltration along the spinal needle track significantly reduced post-spinal back pain and the usage of analgesics in patients undergoing elective cesarean section.
